instruction: Which support team should handle this customer request?
state: {"message":"I forgot my password for the customer portal. How can I reset it so I can sign in again?"}

candidates.text: Candidate: Password reset: The user cannot sign in and needs to reset a forgotten password.
Candidate: Refund request: The user wants their money back for a purchase.
Candidate: Delivery tracking: The user wants to locate an order or check its delivery status.
Candidate: Cancel subscription: The user wants to stop a recurring subscription.
